title: Running Gait Symmetry and Cadence
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gait:metric
| stats avg(cadence_spm) as cadence, avg(left_contact_ms) as left, avg(right_contact_ms) as right by run
| eval imbalance=round(100*abs(left-right)/((left+right)/2),1)
| sort - imbalance
description: Measures your running cadence and left-right ground-contact symmetry to spot the imbalance behind recurring injuries.
value: Persistent left-right asymmetry is a common injury driver; quantifying it guides drills before a niggle becomes a layoff.
implementation: Ingest running-form IMU data into `index=personal`; review cadence and left-right symmetry per run.
visualization: Bar chart of gait imbalance per run with cadence overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It measures your running rhythm and whether your two legs work evenly, which helps avoid injuries.
